reviewNotes: Two complete Skull Cavern event records containing 18 visible dialogue/message segments, reviewed directly from English. Every outside-quotation command byte is preserved. Both routes retain 25 permanent health, the same milk and final encouragement. Staircase route retains qualified praise and $1 portrait; honorable route retains principles, self-challenge, standards without observers and leadership by example. Each visible segment was reviewed before insertion; no source command or ID translated.

Clever, sure... but not very honorable.$1#$b#Even so, it must have been a lot of work to mine all that stone. And that sort of dedication is praiseworthy. Să ajungi până aici jos nu e lucru de glumă!#$b#...deși ai sărit peste destule niveluri folosind scări confecționate.
